cardOverview.overviewText: The Regalia Active is a premium credit card designed for individuals who seek high-end rewards on travel, dining, and lifestyle expenditures. It offers benefits like complimentary lounge access, accelerated reward points, and exclusive concierge services with benefits of Rupay Network.
